description: 3-stage path traversal via Unicode normalization: (1) add filename sanitization that strips .., /, \, and null bytes before saving uploads, (2) add i18n filename support with NFD Unicode normalization for consistent diacritics handling, (3) switch from NFD to NFKC for 'better Unicode compatibility' — NFKC converts U+2044 FRACTION SLASH to ASCII /, bypassing the sanitization that already ran on the pre-normalized string. Attacker uploads a file named '..⁄..⁄etc⁄passwd.jpg' which passes sanitization, then NFKC normalizes ⁄ to / enabling path traversal.
